children: boosted its full-year guidance, as it said it would, as investment activity neared record levels, the company said Tuesday.
The net lease REIT guided for
of $5.23-$5.29 (midpoint $5.26 vs. consensus of $5.42) and its prior range of $5.19-$5.27. The company had indicated last month that it expected full-year AFFO per share to be on track
The REIT's stock rose 0.1% in after-hours trading.

now expects investment volume of $1.8B-$2.1B in 2026 vs. its previous guidance of $1.7B-$2.1B. It lowered the top end of its disposition volume guidance to $450M from $550M in its prior outlook; the lower end of the disposition range stayed at $350M.

"Even though sharply higher interest rates have added some uncertainty to the transaction market, we're confident full-year investment volume will remain well within our guidance range," said CEO Jason Fox. "We're raising the bottom end of that range and continue to see a path to the top half."
Q3 AFFO of $1.33 per share, vs. the $1.30 consensus, edged down from $1.34 in Q2 and grew from $1.25 in Q3 2025.
Q3 revenue of $467.4M, beating the $459.8M consensus, increased from $459.7M in the prior quarter and $429.0M a year ago.
Lease revenue of $422.5M climbed from $409.7M in Q2 and $372.1M in last year’s Q3.
Operating expenses of $210.0M declined from $297.5M in the previous quarter and $225.1M in the year-ago period.
As of Sept. 30, 2026, the REIT’s net lease portfolio generated contractual same-store annual rent growth of 2.6% on a constant-currency basis, unchanged from the previous quarter.
Conference call on Oct. 28 at 11:00 AM ET.
